'''Robux Shop''' ---- The '''Robux Shop''' is a place where you can buy currencies, such as {{Coins|Coins}} and {{Gem|Gems}}, [[gamepasses]] and [[Towers]] (such as the [[Crook Boss]]) with {{Robux|Robux}}. The '''Robux Shop''' can be found within the store GUI under the two rightmost tabs. The '''Robux Shop''' is further divided into the categories seen below. ----
